description.summary: The caster emulates the jubjub bird’s defense mechanism
description.value: The caster emulates the jubjub bird’s defense mechanism. When damaged by an attack that causes earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, or wind damage, the caster may cast this spell to gain resistance 30 to that elemental type until the end of its next turn. If an attack causes more than one type of elemental damage, the caster gains resistance 30 to all the types of elemental damage dealt. Learned From jubjub bird
